'''B-9D7''' was the personal assistant of [[Movo Brattakin]].

==Biography==
When [[Olag Greck]] crashed into Brattakin's private hangar, Brattakin was fatally wounded. B-9D7 saved him by removing his brain and placing it in the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] cranium. In the droid body, Brattakin deceived his associates, while carrying out his plan to start a droid rebellion and topple [[Boonda/Legends|Boonda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. The plot was foiled by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and Brattakin's droid body was decapitated by a shot from [[Jace Forno]]'s blaster.
